text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while passing in front of a pet 
shop in town――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I must protect them...! I want to 
protect... these children...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...There stood Yaeno Muteki, completely 
melting at the sight of the cute animals.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Both that kitten and that puppy... What 
pure and innocent, round eyes they have.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Unlike those in the wild, perhaps none of 
them know how to survive on their own...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My martial arts... the Kongo Yaegaki 
Style! Exists precisely to protect the 
vulnerable!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now that it has come to this, until every 
single one of these pups finds an owner, I 
shall stand guard over this shop as their 
protectorââ
choice_data_list: Isn't that pushing it a bit too far……?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
C-Could it be... Did you just see me... 
like that...!?

harsh ascetic training.

You've got an interesting side to you, 
huh.

You've got an interesting side to you, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Special training……! Y-Yes, that is 
precisely it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
By deliberately disrupting my own 
emotions, I sought to strengthen my mental 
fortitude!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Though it is a grueling and agonizing 
path, it is all to pursue the ultimate 
martial way...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With sweat glistening on her brow, Yaeno 
Muteki looked somehow deeply powerful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki took the alley corner with 
breathtaking precision and sprinted out of 
sight...
